owner_finding_verified_at_origin_main.requirement: >= 2 consecutive pipe-bearing lines plus a non-empty _parse_grid. No separator row, no equal widths, no minimum column count, no body row.
owner_finding_verified_at_origin_main.docstring_states_rather_than_checks: Prose almost never produces consecutive pipe lines, so this is robust without a heuristic cutoff.

reproduction_as_a_live_defect.note: The required regression passes TRIVIALLY at origin/main -- there is no D3 keep path there, the marker always fires, and the assertion is vacuous. The code that HAS the defect is this branch's own round-2 head, so that is where it was measured.
reproduction_as_a_live_defect.observed: Four sentences of prose shipped in place of the D3 marker, under a flag note claiming a table was kept, on a page with nothing usable on it.

strict_predicate.name: socr.tables.reconcile.has_strict_table_grid
conditions: a real separator row is present, every cell matching :?-{3,}:?
every row in the block has the same cell count
at least one body row AFTER the separator
strict_predicate.callers: one -- the #262 D3 keep predicate in manifest.d3_floor_kept_model_output
strict_predicate.find_table_blocks_unchanged_evidence: src/socr/tables/reconcile.py:find_table_blocks is byte-identical to origin/main; the strict check is additive, and tests/test_gh262_d3_marker_over_cached_grid.py::test_find_table_blocks_itself_is_unchanged pins that the loose helper still returns 1 block for bare prose, a half grid and a single column.

three_required_assertions.direction: prose with pipes is NOT an authored grid; the marker still fires
three_required_assertions.fixture_note: PROSE_WITH_PIPES has two CONSECUTIVE pipe-bearing lines by construction, so it genuinely exercises the loose parser rather than passing for the wrong reason.

three_required_assertions.direction: a half-emitted grid (header + separator, no body) is NOT an authored grid
a real grid STILL supersedes the marker -- the tightening must not make the fix inert

supporting_tests.why: Grounding. Asserts find_table_blocks returns >=1 block for the prose and half-grid fixtures. Without it, a fixture that quietly stopped having two adjacent pipe lines would make both negative guards pass for the wrong reason.
Each of the four conditions separately, so a failure names which one broke. Reached via getattr on the module so the baseline fails behaviourally, not with ImportError.
Scope guard on the loose/strict split.

merge_required_adjustments: The keep predicate excludes _NATIVE_TEXT_LANES rather than the 'native' prefix -- #265's review finding applies verbatim, since the chart lane (PP-7) ships native_text and native text is exactly what this floor distrusts.

The predicate declines outright on native_rotated_text_shredded, leaving #263's fail-closed floor untouched. Conservative: the keep-a-soft-refused-grid argument may apply there too, but that is #263's call.

flagged_to_owner.ragged_grids: 'Equal row widths' means a RAGGED but genuine grid no longer supersedes the marker, so such a page ships zero content -- where #259's precedent (kept_table_grid_defect) flags and keeps it. A content-loss trade in the opposite direction from the one this ticket opened. Built to the stated spec and flagged, not silently traded.
flagged_to_owner.commit_hygiene: The merge commit also carries the round-3 change; they landed together by mistake and the commit message says so explicitly. Splitting after the fact would have meant re-resolving the merge by hand, the riskier operation on a third round.

existing_tests_changed: NONE in round 3. The two carried from earlier rounds are unchanged: tests/test_gh95_tables_trust.py (regex widened to see a digit) and tests/test_gh259_flagged_model_table_wins.py (D3 reverse guard amended to the scope where it holds). tests/test_gh205_tr3_unconditional_event.py remains reverted to main.
